verdict.rationale: EBANX is a payments platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only adjacent AI aids: Agent Skills guidance for coding assistants, an llms.txt file, and an integration prompt. Nothing shows an official MCP server that an agent can connect to, so these do not count toward the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
